# System playbook reference

aiHelpDesk ships 46 system playbooks (29 triage, 17 remediation). They are embedded in the service binaries and seeded into auditd at startup (see [System Playbooks](PLAYBOOKS.md#system-playbooks)). This page is generated from the YAML files in `playbooks/`: the version, agent, approval mode and the playbooks each one hands off to are read from the files, so it cannot drift from what ships. A *triage* playbook diagnoses and ends in a hand-off; a *remediation* playbook acts, under the approval its mode requires. Every triage playbook carries a `root_cause_classes` taxonomy (see [ATTRIBUTION_CERTS.md](ATTRIBUTION_CERTS.md)) and no remediation playbook does; a test enforces both.

An *entry point* is a playbook an investigation can start from: the triage entry points are matched against a query's symptoms by [automatic selection](API.md#automatic-routing-and-playbook-selection). A playbook that is not an entry point is reached through a hand-off from another playbook.

| Series ID | Name | Version | Agent | Problem class | Entry point | Approval | Hands off to | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pbs_bgwriter_remediate` | Checkpoint Warning — Reset bgwriter_lru_maxpages | 1.4 | database | performance | yes | manual | — | Restore bgwriter_lru_maxpages to its default (100) after it has been set abnormally low, causing the bgwriter to be throttled and forcing backends to write dirty pages themselves. |
| `pbs_cache_miss_remediate` | High Cache Miss Ratio — Remediation | 1.1 | database | performance | no | manual | — | Confirm the cache miss condition is still active, then reset the buffer cache statistics so the ratio reflects only current normal activity. |
| `pbs_connection_remediate` | Connection Overload — Terminate Idle Sessions | 1.5 | database | availability | yes | manual | — | Remediate connection pool exhaustion or a session stuck in idle-in-transaction by terminating the sessions responsible. |
| `pbs_db_backup_archiving_remediate` | WAL Archiving Failing — Restore archive_command | 1.0 | database | availability | no | manual | — | Restore WAL archiving after archive_command has been confirmed broken by pbs_db_backup_health_triage. |

| `pbs_k8s_node_pressure_remediate` | K8s Node Memory Pressure — Remediation | 1.0 | k8s | availability | no | manual | — | Verify recovery after a node memory-pressure event near a PostgreSQL pod, based on triage findings. |
| `pbs_k8s_pod_crash_remediate` | K8s Pod Crash — Remediation | 1.0 | k8s | availability | no | manual | — | Remediate a crashed or restarting PostgreSQL pod based on triage findings. |
